answer: To forge 1,000 identities I must first pay for every work slot they will occupy. Each slot takes a 90-unit escrow deposit, locked for 3 epochs, and a VRF beacon draws 7 jurors per epoch to audit the work. Fake work burns the whole deposit. Two strikes freeze all my slot deposits for 20 epochs. The orchard looks rich from outside, but each tree costs 90 units to plant, and a 30% fraud rate burns 27,000 units per round. Honest agents get the deposit back after 3 clean epochs. My signal of profit dies at the first audit: the lotus of free sybil work is a trap.
